verdict.rationale: Granola offers extensive AI-generated insight features directly in-product: Chat for asking questions and spotting patterns across notes (docs-4, docs-19), Recipes for templated insight generation (docs-6), pre-meeting briefs with AI-surfaced context (docs-44), auto-drafted follow-up emails using transcript/calendar/Gmail context (docs-45), and speaker/summary customization templates (docs-7). This goes beyond simple export/search into genuine agentic suggestions (drafting emails, Slack messages, calendar events) surfaced inside the app. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of insight quality or accuracy is thin (only vendor docs, no third-party review of Chat/Recipes output quality).
